# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.

completion:
Determine which districts the inspected structure is in (remember it is possible for the same structure to cross more than one district and should be recorded in each of the districts).
3. Select criteria for the physical condition ratings for components at EBRSDot. Bridge condition ratings are assigned individually and collectively to the deck, superstructure, substructure, culverts, piers, piles, abutments, trusses, tendons, beams, cross bracing, tracks (vertical, longitudinal, and eyebar), shop assemblies, stringers, and piles, bearing devices, guard rails, and miscellaneous metal components. The six condition rating categories are:

   - Excellent; Slightly Damaged; Based on the FHWA guidelines, condition ratings shall be assigned Bridge Elements and Subcritical Elements are rated by Primary Routing as well as specifying deficiencies, such as fractures, existing repairs and deterioration. Findings are documented on the LD Forms for repairs, such as fractures
